variants.headline: {first_name}, try our two-part machine-washable rugs.
variants.body: Designed with a practical two-part system, these rugs are machine-washable and built for homes with pets, kids, and everyday messes.
variants.angle: Focusing strictly on the functional utility of the two-part machine-washable system to handle messes, avoiding any unverified eco-claims.
claims_used: Machine-washable rugs with a two-part system.
Great for pet owners and families with young kids who have messes.
